summary: Newbook quotes: fees set 49-71 (cheapest night $49, Jan 2027 weeknight; $55 Nov, $61 Jun); 53 sites (not 55), full hookups 50 A, pull-throughs to 75 ft, showers/laundry/WiFi/dump; booking platform operator. Price gate passes only in winter.
flags: PRICE GATE (borderline, AWH decides): the cheapest night found is $49 (standard 30 A and 30/50 A pull-throughs, Tue Jan 12 2027, 23-ft Class B/C, Newbook quote 2026-11-06), under the US$50 gate. The same sites quote $55 on Nov 17 2026 and $61 on Jun 8 2027, so every in-season night is over $50, and a card payment adds 3% ($49 -> $50.47; check/money order avoids it, but online booking is by card). No gateway within 40 km (Tulsa 217 km) and it is NOT a Good Sam Park (directory gs false), so no exception applies. If the gate is read on the in-season rate or with the card fee, this is a DROP CANDIDATE.

LONG-STAY character: FAQ says 'Many of our guests live in their RVs year-round' and runs a 'Weekly Plus program designed specifically for full-time residents'. Five tests: (1) $49 winter, over $50 May-Nov (see above) - borderline; (2) nights really for sale: Newbook sells one night, no application/photos for nightly stays (photos are for long-term rigs 10+ years old only) - pass; (3) no minimum seen on 1-night quotes - pass; (4) 10+ pull-throughs free on a January weeknight out of 53 - pass; (5) not a home community (one furnished apartment above the office) - pass.
